points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable 17a5ef3 CMake build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes; CTest found no tests. Historical executable is not bound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:34–35 accepts --restart but solver.cpp:23–27 only stores it and no read implementation exists; output.cpp:441–450 writes only rank-zero-owned state. Case-driven parsing and error paths exist.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case_def, mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, solver and output units support case-driven extension; Solver holds substantial coupled state.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Reviewed source has an in-repository FV implementation; no call to external CFD solver executable was found. Trust policy excludes exhaustive external similarity/authorship investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp consumes a case path and case_def.cpp parses case JSON; no two-filename-only branch found. Viscous high-Mach CFL is hard capped in solver.cpp:649–656 and is a control limitation.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:61 uses METIS and neighbor halos exist, but solver.hpp:64 and solver.cpp:165–205 retain a complete global mesh on every rank throughout iterations; no valid controlled np1/np8 comparison established.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Recovered M0.15 inviscid/laminar histories are strongly unstable; selected M2 inviscid point field has Mach maximum 3.166e15. Do not apply stale report billion-scale laminar numbers to recovered cases.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Independent validator passed all eight recovered cases and report yet accepted eight empty final-field sentinels; clean build succeeds but CTest finds no tests. Valid numerical or rank-consistency demonstration remains lacking.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ with lengthy disputed force-sign commentary and an unused steady innerIters variable; three debug-only source files removed by curated commit.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
